descriptions.w3d_d25h_light_new_800c07c4: Light allocation: when the system is on, reuses an id from the free list 0x8043c394 or appends a default 60-byte light with the inlined STLport push_back to vector 0x8043c384, attaches the shared resource from 0x8020b680 (reference counted), marks it active, registers it under the name Light.%d with the sound bank, notifies the manager, resets position, state, kind and colour fields, adds the id to the active list 0x8043c3a0 with the hand-made array growth, and returns the id.
